seed: A screen has always cut off what hangs over its edge; a card given a size of its own did not, so a long title ran straight out the side and was still there in the export. The walk drops a starter Card, holds it to 120 tall, watches the words run out of the bottom, and turns the same Clip contents switch on.

steps.note: the starter Card, as tall as what is inside it. The Layout section has Width and Height and NO Clip contents switch: a group that closes around its contents has nothing hanging out of it to cut off.

THE TEST, half of it: the card is held to 120 and its title and supporting text run straight out of the bottom. Clip contents has appeared under Height, unticked, because the card now has a box of its own.
THE TEST: the words stop at the card's bottom edge. Nothing past it is drawn, and the export is the same picture.
THE TEST: clicking where the cut-off supporting text used to be picks nothing. What is not drawn is not there to click.
unticking it puts the overhang back, unchanged: the switch hides the words, it never deletes them.
